title: Stag and Doe Ideas: Games, Toonie Toss and Guest Photos | Albums.ink
desc: Stag and doe ideas for Canada: toonie toss, dollar dance, raffles and one QR album that collects every guest's photos from the hall.
h1: Stag and doe ideas: games that raise cash and one album for every guest photo
lead: A stag and doe (stag & doe) is the Canadian wedding fundraiser that fills a hall with coworkers, cousins and friends who may never make the wedding guest list. The toonie toss and dollar dance raise money — and create photo moments that vanish into private camera rolls. Here are stag and doe ideas that work in Ontario, Alberta and beyond, plus a simple way to keep every guest photo in one place.
body: ## Classic games guests actually play
- Toonie toss: coins toward a bottle or prize — crowds form every round.
- Dollar dance: a short dance with the couple for a loonie or toonie; the line is full of candid photos.
- 50/50 draw: half the pot to a winner, half to the couple — announce it loud so someone captures the cheer.
- Silent auction / raffle tables: donated baskets and gift cards keep people moving between games.
- Photo bingo: cards with moments to capture (toonie toss winner, first pie, dance floor) so guests hunt for pictures instead of only scrolling.
## Where the best photos happen
Doors, game tables, the dollar dance line and last call on the dance floor. Hired coverage often misses the late, loud part of the night — that is exactly when guests take the funniest videos.
## Collect every guest photo with one QR code
An event album on Albums replaces “send me your pics” the next morning:
1. Create the album, e.g. “Alex & Sam Stag & Doe 2026”.
2. Print the QR on the ticket table, bar and each game station.
3. Guests scan with their phone camera and upload from the browser — nothing to install.
4. Turn on “Hold guest photos” if you want to approve uploads first.
5. After the night, download the whole album as one ZIP.
Guests can upload without signing in. Anyone who signs in also gets a private copy of just their own uploads.

faq: What is a stag and doe?
A Canadian wedding fundraiser — usually a ticketed hall night with games, a cash bar and dancing that raises money for the couple.
What are good stag and doe ideas?
Toonie toss, dollar dance, 50/50, raffles, photo bingo and a QR album so every guest's photos land in one place.
How do I collect photos from stag and doe guests?
Print a QR code at the door and game tables. Guests scan and upload photos and videos from the browser.
